name: @citrineos/ocpp-server
description: The OCPP server implementation which acts right on top of an asynchronous WebSocket.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.src.json && tsc -p tsconfig.migrations.json && pnpm run copy-assets
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec sequelize-cli db:migrate --debug && echo migration completed successfully
scripts.start:everest: cd ./everest && cross-env OCPP_VERSION=2.1 EVEREST_IMAGE_TAG=2025.6.1-dt-esdp docker compose up -d
scripts.start:everest:16: cd ./everest && cross-env OCPP_VERSION=1.6 EVEREST_IMAGE_TAG=2025.6.1-dt-esdp docker compose up -d

author: S44
